title: Finite coefficient-stage compact-support projection laws
statement: Let S be the specified six-functor operation datum [def-fix-six-functor-datum] for finite-field datum D, coefficient datum C, finite extension E of Q_l and positive finite level n. The canonical compact-support projection of [def-sf-constructible-projection-mates] satisfies CompactSupportFiniteProjection.Laws for (i) S.toSixFunctorFiniteOperations, (ii) every S.integralNormalization.finiteLevels m, and (iii) every (S.coefficientIntegralNormalization E0).finiteLevels m for E0 a finite coefficient field of C.Qbar and m a natural number. These laws assert invertibility on arbitrary bounded constructible first inputs and finite-Tor second inputs, naturality, compactification independence, composition, the associativity pentagon and proper-counit identification. No separatedness of the structure maps is imposed.

proof.text: Work uniformly with any SixFunctorFiniteOperations. Choose fixed-scalar etale origins using the finite-ring constructible derived-origin theorem and the constructible sheaf comparison. Transfer the finite Tor interval along the realization counit and intrinsic Tor-amplitude comparison. Apply the general finite-ring theorem hasProjectionFormulaOfCompactification_of_boundedConstructible in the adopted ProjectionFormula source module. The three factors defining component are isomorphisms, and the full-subcategory inclusion reflects them.

proof.text: Construct support and pullback realization natural isomorphisms. At an arbitrary coefficient category, uncurry the canonical projection, whisker by the two input functors and output realization, and conjugate by the endpoint natural isomorphisms. Derive its coordinate naturality equation before specializing the coefficients. Identify the two coordinate components using the source and target comparison equations. Faithfulness of the full-subcategory inclusion gives naturality of component.

lean.statement:
theorem compactSupportProjectionFormula_finiteStages
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum}
    {E : Type u} [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] {n : ℕ} {hn : 1 ≤ n}
    (S : SixFunctorOperationDatum D C E n hn) :
    CompactSupportFiniteProjection.Laws S.toSixFunctorFiniteOperations ∧
    (∀ m : ℕ, CompactSupportFiniteProjection.Laws
      (S.integralNormalization.finiteLevels m)) ∧
    ∀ E₀ : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields C.l C.Qbar, ∀ m : ℕ,
      CompactSupportFiniteProjection.Laws
        ((S.coefficientIntegralNormalization E₀).finiteLevels m)
